client_claims.text: Monzo is designed to work as a UK main current account: salary can be paid in, Direct Debits and standing orders set up.
If paid by Bacs, Monzo says it can make the money available one business day early.
Monzo treats an account as your main account if you receive at least £500 every 35 days and have an active Direct Debit.
client_claims.note: F7 mentions main bank but not the criteria.

client_claims.text: Monzo is app-based and has no traditional branch network.
Salary Sorter automatically splits incoming salary into Pots for bills, spending, and savings.
The Current Account Switch Service can move balances, Direct Debits and standing orders to Monzo.
